title: Maagizo (Theme 7: Sebuleni)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child hears the whole instruction, counts its steps on his fingers, and does them in order; when giving one, he names the action and the thing.

floor.prerequisite: Does a one-step action on hearing it.
floor.question: Simama!

representations: action cards: simama, keti, chukua, weka
a band on the right hand
steps: Give one instruction to a partner.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child does both steps and gives a two-step instruction to a partner.

misconceptions.repair: Sikiliza agizo lote kwanza, kisha fanya hatua zote.

misconceptions.ask: Neno lipi linakuambia hatua ya pili?

misconceptions.repair: Weka kikombe juu ya meza. maana yake ni anakiweka juu ya meza.
Agizo zuri linasema nini kifanyike, kwa kitu gani, na kwa adabu.

checks.question: Agizo "Keti kisha ufungue kitabu" lina hatua ngapi?
Toa agizo la adabu la kumwomba mwenzako afunge mlango.
